name: Oyster
rule: Spreader. When it fruits, it colonizes one adjacent empty Straw square.
blurb: Fans of soft grey shelves. The bed you start with.

name: Wine Cap
rule: Aggressive spreader. When it fruits, it colonizes an adjacent empty Woodchip square. If there is none, it takes over an adjacent Puffball bed.
blurb: A garden giant that loves fresh wood chips.

name: Puffball
rule: Grows on the compost your lookalikes leave behind, so a bad pick still feeds the farm.
blurb: A soft white moon in the grass.

name: Shiitake
rule: A steady earner on logs in spring and fall: plant it early in the season and it fruits before the season ends.
blurb: Speckled brown caps that crack like bread crust.

name: Lion's Mane
rule: Needs shade. Only grows on a square beside a Tree.
blurb: A cascade of white icicles on old hardwood.

name: Reishi
rule: Slow. Two growth phases at C. Plant it by midsummer and it fruits by fall.
blurb: A glossy kidney of red-brown lacquer.

name: Enoki
rule: Grows through fall and winter, and ignores Cold Snap.
blurb: Wild velvet shank: honey caps on dark velvet stems in the snow.

name: Chanterelle
rule: Can't be planted. Once identified it goes straight to storage. Drawn outside summer, it's an empty patch.
blurb: Apricot-scented gold with false gills running down the stem.

name: Morel
rule: Can't be planted. Spring only: all through the Burn Scar, and a deep find in the Mixed Woods. Once identified it goes straight to storage.
blurb: A honeycomb cone that rises from ash the spring after a fire.

name: Porcini
rule: Can't be planted. Old-growth only, fall only. The most valuable thing in the forest.
blurb: A bread-bun cap on a barrel stem, deep under the old pines.

name: Black Trumpet
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Old-growth, and in the Hollow. Summer and fall.
blurb: Ash-grey trumpets that vanish into the leaf litter.

name: Hen of the Woods
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Mixed Woods, and in the Hollow. Fall only.
blurb: A ruffled grey hen roosting at the foot of an oak.

name: Blewit
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Meadow, and in the Hollow. Fall and winter.
blurb: A cold-weather cap in lilac and violet, smelling of orange juice.

name: Truffle
rule: Can't be planted. Only in winter: in the Hollow, or dug from under oak and hazel with a Spade. Worth more than anything else you can find.
blurb: A warty black knob under the roots, and a smell you can't forget.

name: St. George's Mushroom
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Meadow, spring only.
blurb: A stout cream cap in a ring in the grass, up around St. George's Day and smelling of fresh meal.

name: Fairy Ring Champignon
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Meadow, summer only.
blurb: Small tan caps that come up in a ring on the lawn after summer rain, and dry out and revive.

name: Chicken of the Woods
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Mixed Woods, summer only.
blurb: Bright orange and sulphur-yellow shelves stacked up an old oak. Tastes, they say, like chicken.

name: Wood Ear
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Mixed Woods, winter only.
blurb: Soft brown ears on the elder branches, swelling with every winter thaw.

name: Spring King Bolete
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Old-growth, spring only.
blurb: A ruddy porcini that pushes up through the needles while the snowmelt is still running.

name: Yellowfoot
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Old-growth, winter only.
blurb: Small brown funnels on hollow yellow stems, carpeting the moss long after the first frost.

name: Black Morel
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Burn Scar, spring only.
blurb: A tall, sooty morel that comes up thickest where the fire burned hottest.

name: Matsutake
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find in the Hollow, fall only. Prized almost as much as truffle.
blurb: A thick-stemmed cap with cinnamon scales, half buried under the pines, smelling of spice.

name: Dryad's Saddle
rule: Can't be planted. Riverbank only, spring only. Drawn outside spring, it's an empty patch.
blurb: A broad tan shelf with brown feathery scales, on dying elms and willows by the water. It smells of watermelon rind.

name: Shaggy Mane
rule: Can't be planted. Riverbank only, summer and fall. Drawn outside them, it's an empty patch.
blurb: A tall white cap in shaggy scales on the gravel bars, which melts into black ink within a day of picking.

name: Half-free Morel
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find on the Riverbank, spring only.
blurb: A small honeycomb cap perched on a long hollow stem, under the cottonwoods on the river bottom.

name: Lobster Mushroom
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find on the Riverbank, summer only.
blurb: Not quite a mushroom: a mold that swallows a milk cap whole and turns it the color of a boiled lobster.

name: Cauliflower Mushroom
rule: Can't be planted. A deep find on the Riverbank, fall only.
blurb: A head of cream ribbons the size of a hat at the foot of an old pine on the high bank.

name: Collared Earthstar
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season: under the Meadow and the Burn Scar.
blurb: A puffball sitting in a star of split skin, like an egg in a cup.

name: Charcoal Burner
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season, in the old charcoal kiln under the Burn Scar.
blurb: A cap of smoke and violet that bends without breaking. Named for the folk who tended the kilns.

name: Bleeding Tooth
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season, in the hollows under the Mixed Woods.
blurb: Weeps beads of red sap from a pale cap. Too bitter to eat; collectors pay well for it.

name: Bitter Oyster
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season, on old roots and drowned wood.
blurb: Little tan fans whose gills glow green in the dark. Sold to collectors, not cooks.

name: Ghost Fungus
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season: the caves under the Old-growth, and the deepest places.
blurb: Pale funnels that light a cave with a cold green glow. Sold to collectors, never cooks.

name: Scarlet Elf Cup
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season, wherever water stands still: grottos and old wells.
blurb: Bright scarlet cups on sunken twigs, the only color in a dark grotto.

name: Violet Webcap
rule: Can't be planted. Found only underground, in any season, among the ruins under the Hollow.
blurb: Violet so dark it is nearly black, with a cobweb veil under the cap.
